name: feedmixer
description_en: Micro web service which takes a list of feed URLs and returns a new feed consisting of the most recent n entries from each given feed (returns Atom, RSS, or JSON). ([Demo](https://mretc.net/feedmixer/json?f=https://hnrss.org/newest&f=https://americancynic.net/atom.xml&n=1)) `WTFPL` `Python`
description: A self-hosted API to fetch and mix entries from Atom and RSS feeds (returns Atom, RSS, or JSON)
readme_preview:
FeedMixer ========= FeedMixer is a little web service (Python3/WSGI) which takes a list of feed URLs and  combines them into a single (Atom, RSS, or JSON) feed. Useful for personal news aggregators, "planet"-like websites, etc.
